sentences.text: Over the next fifteen lessons, we’re going to work through the Navigation Rules together, the part of the captain’s exam that trips up more people than any other.
Every other module needs seventy percent to pass.
Out of fifty questions, you can miss only about five.
So we’ll cover every rule, from Rule one through Rule thirty-eight, plus the annexes the exam pulls from, and after each lesson there’s a short check so you can make sure it stuck.
Don’t worry about memorizing everything today.
Just get comfortable with how the rules are built.
The memorizing comes later, and I’ll give you plenty of tricks for it.
